headline: OJK Sanctions 4 Perpetrators of HOMI Manipulation, Peeks at Figure Controlling This Issuer
summary: Indonesia's financial services authority OJK imposed sanctions on four parties involved in manipulating shares of PT Grand House Mulia Tbk (HOMI), with unlawful gains of Rp6.89 billion.
why: The OJK regulates Indonesia's capital markets, and enforcement against share manipulation protects investor confidence in listed stocks.
original_headline: OJK Sanksi 4 Pelaku Manipulasi HOMI, Intip Sosok Pengendali Emiten Ini
